import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=df['t'].values; A=df['A'].values; y=df['dA_dt'].values
V=np.var(y)
def run(name,f,p0s,n=40):
    best=None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    for s in range(n):
        p0=np.array(p0s)*np.exp(rng.standard_normal(len(p0s))*0.7)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p: f(p)-y, p0, max_nfev=3000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception: pass
    print(name, np.mean((f(best.x)-y)**2)/V, np.round(best.x,4))
